---

## 1. Company Overview

Baglamukhi Tour & Travels is a licensed North Indian travel and fleet operator specializing in Himachal Pradesh mountain tourism. Founded by local Himachali travel experts, the company operates commercial (yellow-plate) tourist vehicles equipped with All India Tourist Permits (AITP), Fastag, and mountain safety gear.

### Key Value Propositions
- 100% Native Pahadi Chauffeurs with 10+ years experience navigating steep ghat hairpin bends, snow, and landslide zones.
- Guaranteed transparent pricing with zero hidden surcharges for toll taxes, interstate permits, parking, or driver night allowances.
- Instant pickup at Amb Andaura Railway Station (AADR) for passengers arriving via New Delhi - Amb Andaura Vande Bharat Express (Train No. 22447 / 22448).
- Specialized darshan facilitation and yellow havan samagri assistance at Maa Baglamukhi Dham Bankhandi Kangra.

All fleet models include experienced driver, commercial yellow license plates, luggage carrier, and all-weather AC/heater.

- Luggage: Heavy-duty metal rooftop carrier + rear boot
- Base Fare: ₹4,500/day
- Rate per Km: ₹18/km

## 3. Major Travel Routes & Distances

- Amb Andaura Railway Station (AADR) to Maa Baglamukhi Temple (Bankhandi): 45 km | 1.0 hr
- Amb Andaura to Mata Chintpurni Temple: 25 km | 45 min
- Amb Andaura to Mata Jwala Ji Temple: 55 km | 1.5 hrs
- Amb Andaura to Dharamshala / McLeodganj: 95 km | 2.5 hrs
- Chandigarh to Maa Baglamukhi Temple (Bankhandi): 190 km | 4.5 hrs
- Chandigarh to Shimla: 115 km | 3.5 hrs
- Chandigarh to Manali: 270 km | 6.5 hrs
- Manali to Atal Tunnel & Sissu: 40 km | 1.0 hr
- Chandigarh to Dharamshala: 245 km | 5.0 hrs
- Pathankot Cantt to Dalhousie & Khajjiar: 85 km | 2.5 hrs
- Delhi IGI Airport to Chandigarh: 250 km | 4.0 hrs

## 4. Curated Himachal Tour Packages

1. **Maa Baglamukhi Dham & 9 Devi Darshan Circuit (6 Days / 5 Nights)**
   - Route: Chandigarh / Amb Andaura -> Mansa Devi -> Naina Devi -> Chintpurni -> Jwala Ji -> Baglamukhi Bankhandi -> Kangra Brajeshwari -> Chamunda Devi -> Golden Temple Amritsar.
   - Includes: Dedicated private cab, hotels with breakfast & dinner, VIP darshan assistance.
   - URL: https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/9-devi-darshan-himachal-yatra

2. **Shimla & Manali Complete Hill Holiday (6 Days / 5 Nights)**
   - Route: Chandigarh -> Shimla (Kufri, Mall Road) -> Kullu (Rafting, Shawl Factory) -> Manali (Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel, Hadimba Temple) -> Chandigarh.
   - URL: https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/shimla-manali-honeymoon-package

3. **Dharamshala, McLeodganj & Dalhousie Khajjiar Tour (5 Days / 4 Nights)**
   - Highlights: Dalai Lama Monastery, HPCA Cricket Stadium, Bhagsunag Waterfall, Khajjiar lake (Mini Switzerland), Kalatop wildlife sanctuary.
   - URL: https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/dharamshala-dalhousie-5-days-tour

4. **Spiti Valley High Altitude Road Expedition (7 Days / 6 Nights)**
   - Route: Manali -> Atal Tunnel -> Kunzum Pass -> Kaza -> Key Gompa -> Kibber -> Chicham Bridge -> Hikkim (World's Highest Post Office) -> Langza -> Chandratal Moon Lake -> Manali.
   - URL: https://www.a1baglamukhitours.in/tours/spiti-valley-road-trip-7-days
